title: job.heartbeat (v1)
description: Liveness of a running attempt, every 10 s (live) / 30 s (other kinds). Routing key `job.<kind>.<jobId>.heartbeat.v1`, AMQP type `events.v1.JobHeartbeat`, transient, `expiration` = 2 x interval. Consumed by job-orchestrator: 3 missed heartbeats mark a live deployment `stale` and revoke its lease epoch; for backtests they enforce `deadline`.

engineAlive.description: Whether the child engine process is still running.
